assessment: This paper reveals that the phosphoprotein (P) of a plant negative-sense RNA virus, Barley yellow striate mosaic virus (BYSMV), forms condensates through liquid-liquid phase separations (LLPSs). Using BYSMV minireplicon system, they show that the unphosphorylated P protein undergoes phase separation to promote virus replication. Whereas, the host casein kinase 1 (CK1) phosphorylates P protein to inhibit phase separation and virus replication.
